text:
ara: Quick idea 1: handheld showdown + SteamDeck lounge this Thursday? bring whatever portable you have, we'll set up a PC corner for Parsec co-op and a charger station.
toby: Love it. I can bring my Steam Deck and a spare SD card with a few retro emus. Also a small USB-C hub for charging.
nina: I'm down if there's room for a tabletop switch for Mario Party chaos. Also can we do a tiny speedrun corner for Celeste? :eyes:
sam: Heads up my Deck's battery is wonky at 40% 1
Any volunteers to lug a power brick and a 10ft cable?
izzy: I have a 100W USB-C PD brick and a 10ft cable. I can also bring a 2-port HDMI capture if anyone wants to stream highlights.
nina: :one: for 7pm start, :two: for 8pm.
oby: ops-bot: Poll created: 1) 7pm 2) 8pm. Vote with reactions.
toby: :one:
ara: 7pm works. Plan: set up chargers + ethernet for the PC corner (Parsec needs low latency). Can someone bring an ethernet switch?
izzy: I'll bring a small gigabit switch and a couple cables.
sam: I can bring beanbags and a power strip. Also, can we do a small sticker-swap table? I have old badges.
nina: yes stickers always. Also optional Steam key drop 1
if anyone has spare Humble keys we can leave them on the snack table with a note.
toby: I'll tape a sign: "Take one, pay it forward" :sparkles:
ara: Reminder: parents room booked till 9 so please keep volume reasonable. We can move Smash to the smaller room if it gets loud.
izzy: projector volunteer? I'm happy to handle switching inputs for the first hour.
ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Handheld & Deck Night" (root_ts: 1972000246).
sam: Any dietary restrictions? I'll order two pizzas (veg + meat). Vegan?
nina: one vegan please. thanks.
toby: RSVP if you want a charger slot so I can label them.
ara: RSVP here. I'll bring sticky labels. See you Thursday :controller:
